findings.title: zip(error_ids, events.values()) may misalign when some events are missing from nodestore
findings.body: In `fetch_error_details`, `nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids)` returns a dict containing only the found entries. If some node_ids are not found (data is None or key is absent), `events.values()` will have fewer elements than `error_ids`, and `zip` will silently pair the wrong `event_id` with the wrong `data`. For example, if error_ids is ['a','b','c'] and only 'a' and 'c' are found, the zip will pair 'a' with a's data and 'b' with c's data. The code should iterate over `node_ids` and look up each one individually, or zip `error_ids` with a list built by looking up each node_id in the returned dict.

findings.title: Feature-flagged TableWidgetVisualization renders empty table instead of actual data
findings.body: When the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature flag is enabled, the code renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}} />` with hardcoded empty data, completely ignoring the actual `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, `eventView`, etc. that are available in scope. Users with this feature flag enabled will see an empty table instead of their dashboard widget data. The actual table data (result.data, result.meta, fields) should be passed to the component.

findings.title: Validation of age/timestamp mutual exclusion fails when age=0
findings.body: In `validate_timestamp`, the check `if self.initial_data.get("age")` uses truthiness. If a report contains both `age: 0` and `timestamp: <value>`, `self.initial_data.get("age")` returns `0` which is falsy, so the validation incorrectly passes. The same issue exists in `validate_age` with `self.initial_data.get("timestamp")` if timestamp could be 0 (it has min_value=0). The checks should use `"age" in self.initial_data` or `self.initial_data.get("age") is not None` to correctly detect field presence.

findings.title: Analytics event name changed from 'replay.view_html' to 'replay.view-html' breaking existing tracking
findings.body: The analytics event name was changed from `'replay.view_html'` to `'replay.view-html'`. Any existing dashboards, alerts, or data pipelines that reference the old event name `replay.view_html` will stop receiving data. The corresponding entry in `replayAnalyticsEvents.tsx` was updated to `'replay.view-html'`, but this is still a breaking change for downstream consumers of analytics data. Consider whether this rename is intentional and if any migration or dual-emission period is needed.

findings.title: get_environment_info calls get_recommended_event() per issue which may be expensive
findings.body: `get_environment_info` is called for each issue in `get_comment_body` (via `get_merged_pr_single_issue_template`). The method calls `issue.get_recommended_event()` which likely involves a database query or Snuba query per issue. For PRs with many linked issues (up to the top 5), this adds N additional queries in a webhook delivery task that already has a 300-second processing deadline. If `get_recommended_event` is expensive, this could cause timeouts.

findings.title: get_request_data mutates the input error_events list via in-place sort
findings.body: `get_request_data` calls `error_events.sort(key=lambda x: x["timestamp"])` which mutates the caller's list in place. While currently the list is freshly created by `fetch_error_details` and not reused, this is a latent bug if the function is ever called with a shared or reused list. Using `sorted(error_events, key=...)` would avoid the mutation.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before feature flag check
findings.body: The `analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...)` call is made before the feature flag check `features.has("organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble", ...)`. This means analytics events are recorded even for organizations that don't have the feature enabled and will receive a 404. If the intent is to track only successful/authorized usage, the analytics call should be moved after the feature flag check.
